title: The APT Foundation Supports Downtown Eastside Women’s Centre’s events
author: Ian
body:
The APT Foundation are proud to support Vancouver’s Downtown Eastside Women’s Centre (DEWC) who have been providing refuge to women and children since 1978. Aiding local women with shelter, crisis relief, and basic necessities, DEWC offers practical support to impact the lives of over 700 women and children every day.

Recently the APT Foundation contributed $6,000 to DEWC’s annual Christmas event, which provided 450 meals and Christmas gift bags to attendees.

The event was held on Columbia Street in front of the Drop-In Centre which was closed specifically for the event. With a large tent set up complete with fairy lights and rows of dinner tables, women were able to come by and enjoy a warm holiday meal, courtesy of the APT Travel Group and the APT Foundation. Volunteer musicians contributed with festive songs while all staff got into the spirit be wearing their favourite Christmas attire.

The APT Foundation will continue to support DEWC’s efforts to expand their Meals Program. These meals are an essential part of the basic needs provided at DEWC’s Drop-In Centre and emergency shelters. Since July 1, 2021, they have seen a 50% increase in the number of women accessing their services; and for many of these women, a meal at DEWC is their only nutrition for the day. They currently serve 750 meals per day and an expansion of our Meals Program will allow them to continue serving the increasing needs of the women in the community.
